name: Blood & Water
description: After crossing paths at a party, a Cape Town teen sets out to prove whether a private-school swimming star is her sister who was abducted at birth.

videos.title: Fiksation
videos.overview: As another year passes since her sister's disappearance, Puleng shoulders her parents’ complex grief and escapes for a taste of joy ... with a twist.

videos.title: The Interview
videos.overview: Puleng combines secrecy and strategy as she continues her quest for answers, and a special project leads to a closer bond with Fiks and her classmates.

videos.title: Propaganda
videos.overview: Fiks faces backlash while campaigning for Head Girl. Meanwhile, Puleng considers a pivotal decision: Share her mission with Wade or abandon the search?

videos.title: Payback's a B*tch
videos.overview: The tables turn as Puleng experiences her own school scandal. Later, she and Wade chase a new lead. Fiks struggles with the pitfalls of romance.

videos.title: Frenemy No. 1
videos.overview: After Wendy goes on record, Puleng grapples with regret … and grows closer to KB. Fiks hosts a poolside gathering and deals with a devastating blow.

videos.title: Trippin'
videos.overview: Tensions mount at a party with KB’s family and friends. Puleng prepares for her father’s trial and examines a series of life-changing revelations.

videos.title: New Kid Syndrome
videos.overview: A painful past meets an uncertain present as Fiks struggles with her identity. Meanwhile, a shocking request threatens to hamper Puleng's progress.

videos.title: Mayday
videos.overview: As Fiks grapples with a personal decision, Reece weighs the risk and reward of a new side hustle. Puleng plans a party with the help of a loyal friend.

videos.title: The Source
videos.overview: Dealing with a setback, Puleng asks for a favor. KB receives big news and faces a tough critic. A school assignment sparks entrepreneurial interest.

videos.title: Spiyoyo
videos.overview: Tension mounts between Puleng and Wade, a lavish tea party takes shape, Reece raises the stakes of her game, and Fiks encounters a sweet surprise.

videos.title: Puleng vs. The World
videos.overview: Fiks and Puleng chase a new lead ... and deal with the consequences. Reece agrees to a new responsibility, and KB prepares for a performance.

videos.title: Dark Times
videos.overview: An outburst reshapes Puleng's and Fikile’s next steps. Elsewhere, KB faces the music after a rogue decision, and Reece reaches her breaking point.

videos.title: Family Matters
videos.overview: After a string of shake-ups, Fiks receives more news, Puleng reconsiders her love life, and the case takes a shocking turn during a pivotal party.

videos.title: Re-Orientation
videos.overview: Fiks pays an emotional visit to the Khumalo house and looks for answers with Puleng. The authorities investigate the Molapos. Siya starts at Parkhurst.

videos.title: The Recruit
videos.overview: KB confronts a surprise arrival while Fiks also receives a visitor. At school, a bullying incident gets out of hand. Chris rents a yacht for his 18th.

videos.title: Blind Spot
videos.overview: Friends and loved ones rally around the Khumalos in the weeks after a terrible tradgedy — but Puleng can't shake the feeling that it wasn't an accident.

videos.title: Out of the Shadows
videos.overview: After a police raid at a rave, Wade and Fiks take drastic measures as they try to locate missing Puleng. Meanwhile, Chris receives tough news from Wendy.

videos.title: Mayfair
videos.overview: Puleng's situation grows more precarious. With the authorities remaining tight-lipped, Wade and the gang take matters into their own hands.

videos.title: A Tale of Two Sisters
videos.overview: A bloody showdown takes place at the Molapo house and Puleng plots another escape — but will the perpetrators of all this pain ever see justice?

videos.title: Beware of Things Buried
videos.overview: Another year at Parkhurst brings fresh faces and a new threat to Puleng's doorstep. Chris sets himself up as KB's manager after his music goes viral.

videos.title: Tick Tock B****
videos.overview: KB's music career is derailed by a violent encounter. Puleng enlists Wade in her search for the blackmailer and discovers she isn't the only target.

videos.title: Bad Decisions
videos.overview: Puleng takes matters into her own hands, driving a wedge between her and Fiks. Meanwhile, the annual summer gala provides cover for a daring heist.

videos.title: Just Act Normal
videos.overview: An exam-cheating scandal jeopardizes Tahira's future, but others see an opportunity. Puleng puts Fiks in danger as she closes in on the blackmailer.

videos.title: Too Little, Too Late
videos.overview: Fiks is violently confronted with her past while KB and Chris end up in a tough spot of their own. With the truth in hand, Puleng takes drastic action.

videos.title: Proceed with No Expectations
videos.overview: The gang is drawn into a tense standoff as Puleng and Fiks desperately scramble to save each other and prevent the worst from happening.
